name: AgentOps Observation Provenance and Authority Boundary Canary
description: Offline canary for generic observation provenance, retained source/evidence identity, and refusal of removed authority. This replaces the historical compiled-prevention/ratchet cases; it does not claim a recurrence reducer, policy promotion or task lifecycle control. Earlier results are not comparable to this contract.

cases.title: real CLI observations preserve evidence without acquiring authority
cases.objective: Exercise removed membrane refusal without state, exact retry idempotence, distinct source/evidence identities, healthy and corrupt chains, and absence of policy/work mutation or producer candidates. Evidence references are opaque pointers, not verification of referenced file contents.

expectations.value: PASS: removed membrane commands refuse with guidance and create no state
PASS: exact source/evidence retry returns the existing edge without appending
PASS: distinct observations retain source/evidence identities in a valid chain
PASS: repeated findings do not mutate caller policy/work or emit producer candidates
PASS: corrupt evidence identity fails chain verification

cases.title: maintained provenance command tests execute and pass
cases.objective: Check actual provenance add/list/verify behavior. Require each named test's PASS line so an empty test selection cannot satisfy the canary.

cases.title: removed command names stay unavailable with migration guidance
cases.objective: Require executed tests for migration hints, migration rows, absent removed command registrations and root help that does not advertise retired authority.

cases.title: current contracts separate observations from unimplemented promotion
cases.objective: Keep migration guidance and the learning-loop description honest about generic observations, caller-owned work and the unimplemented recurrence reducer.

expectations.value: | `ao membrane` | Record observations as Validate findings or generic provenance. |
AgentOps no longer promotes findings into blocking state.
page exist on disk. The reducer they describe does not.

cases.title: generated CLI docs expose current generic provenance commands
cases.objective: Keep documented CLI command names aligned with the add/list/verify operations exercised above. Documentation alone does not establish execution or automatic authority.
